steps: Figure: rectangle split into 2x2 cells by one vertical and one horizontal middle line, plus one diagonal from top-left corner to bottom-right corner through the centre.
Any triangle needs the diagonal plus one vertical and one horizontal line whose crossing point is off the diagonal.
3 vertical x 3 horizontal lines = 9 crossings, minus 3 on the diagonal = 6 triangles (2 large half-rectangles, 4 small in the two cut cells).
check_code:
xs=[0,1,2]; ys=[0,1,2]
n=sum(1 for a in xs for b in ys if a+b!=2)
opts={"A":6,"B":2,"C":4,"D":7}
assert n==opts["A"]
for k in "BCD": assert n!=opts[k]
